answer: I would stop farms with utility bill hash with provider signature, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 654 fakes spends 10464 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One crystal of signal, one inlet of cost, one ferrous of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
